# WO-2026-08-09-B15-A1 - free text as a first-class production answer
# guidance: WO-YYYY-MM-DD-nn — slice title

## Acceptance criteria

AC1 - A BARE TYPED MESSAGE ANSWERS. A Telegram message with NO reply_to_message, arriving while a question is open, reaches commands.answerQuestion and produces a durable asdair.shop_decision. Prove the PRODUCTION path reaches it, cited file:line - not a unit test over a function.

AC2 - IT IS NOT ALSO A SHOPPING LIST. The same message cannot reach commands.receiveList. Prove BOTH halves: the answer lands, AND no shop is created or resumed. This is the defect that would have silently created a new shop from Warwick's answer on a different day.

AC3 - A GENUINE LIST STILL WORKS. A photo, and a typed list sent when NO question is open, both still create a shop exactly as today. The route-first reordering must not eat a real list. Regression-test this explicitly.

AC4 - NOTHING IS SILENTLY DROPPED. Every refused or unroutable inbound leaves a durable trace. runtime.js:235 currently does a bare `continue` with no log at all.

AC5 - PROVENANCE IS TRUTHFUL. A typed answer records answer_source=`typed` and its decision records interpreted_by=`terra` (or `human` on a deterministic exact match), never mislabelled as `button`. commands.js:307 must REJECT an unrecognised source rather than coerce it.

AC6 - UNCERTAINTY IS SPOKEN. When the mapping cannot be grounded confidently, a round-2 clarification question is opened through the EXISTING machinery and it names what was not understood. It must not guess and must not silently park. Warwick: "it should tell me if there is something it does not understand or is not clear!"

AC7 - ONE REPLY MAY SETTLE SEVERAL QUESTIONS where the mapping is safely groundable, with anything unmapped falling to AC6.

AC8 - MUTATION-PROVED. Every control above is broken on purpose, shown RED, restored, shown GREEN. Report the executed count each time; a suite that silently ran nothing is not evidence.

AC9 - NO REGRESSION. bot, intake and pipeline suites green before and after, counts reported both times.

## Sequencing

ONE read-back, then build. TWO DECISIONS ARE ALREADY SETTLED BY LARRY - do not re-open them:

DECISION 1 - what maps a bare reply to a question. Deterministic FIRST: try an exact candidate match (reuse the existing resolveExactCandidate path, no model call). Only if that fails, call Terra ONCE with the raw text plus EVERY open question key and the existing grounding, and let it map. Anything unmapped or low-confidence goes to the EXISTING round-2 clarification path (runPipeline.js:493-528). Never guess, never silently park.

DECISION 2 - intake vs routing order. ROUTE FIRST, INTAKE SECOND. Routing may claim an update ONLY when there is an open question it can correlate to; intake then sees the remainder. This keeps classifyUpdate PURE - do NOT inject an open-question predicate into it - and it stops the same message being both answered and eaten as a list. The guard that matters: if no open question exists, routing must NOT claim the message, so a genuine new shopping list is never lost.

Suggested build order, yours to change: (1) write the FAILING test first that shows a bare typed message is dropped today. (2) Reorder route-before-intake with the no-open-question guard. (3) Relax the reply_to requirement in inboundRouter. (4) Multi-question mapping via Terra. (5) Make every refusal leave a durable trace. (6) Fix the commands.js:307 coercion. Commit in your worktree on b15-3/free-text-and-question-surface. Push the branch. DO NOT open a PR, DO NOT merge, DO NOT touch main.
